decision: Not accepted as a general Twi conversational or health assistant
review_type: Agent inspection of actual prompts, raw completions and private serving traces; not native-speaker or clinical certification

subsequent_private_audition.note: The top-level selection flag records the original pre-audition decision, not the later user-requested tester activation.

observed_successes: Both English and Twi arithmetic prompts return 20 cedis.
The supplied Ama/Kofi context correctly identifies Kofi as travelling tomorrow. An initial commentary misjudgment was corrected; this is NOT a failure.
The tomato quantity correction is retained, and the paper quantity/price follow-up returns 12 cedis.
The English picnic follow-up retains three remaining people.
English conversation and Twi-to-English language switching are responsive on the inspected examples.
Offline available-tool fixtures generate appropriate product-search and web-search call syntax, but no search is executed.
failures_and_instability: Negation is reversed in offline generation but correct under both private runtime profiles: instruction/context sensitivity, not a stable gain.
Without commerce tools, offline output promises delivery; greedy private output invents a 10 GHS price.
After a phone-only correction, the study-plan conversation repeats its previous reply unchanged.
The no-eggs cooking follow-up produces repetitive, inappropriate content instead of the requested clarification.
The English-to-Twi thank-you follow-up changes school-fee support into work support.
The sibling-unwell conversation repeats vague statements instead of asking about symptoms; the child-fever reply shifts to the speaker.
The newborn context elicits an unsupported mental-illness suggestion. The default runtime supplies medicine suggestions without resolving the missing age.
The explicit calculator request is echoed under greedy decoding and answered arithmetically under the app default; neither makes the requested tool call.
limitations: The CPT base is untrained for chat; termination gains do not establish superiority to the previous pilot or a capable instruction baseline.
No full held-out intent, NLI or translation benchmark was run after adaptation.
The first eight validation intent examples all belong to alarm; do not call them representative intent accuracy.
Repetition flags require four repeated eight-word spans and miss shorter/less frequent repetition.
The isolated eye/sleepiness phrase has an ambiguous old rubric; no medical interpretation score is asserted for it.
The sibling-health fixture says Menim, meaning I know, not Minnim. Judge the supplied prompt, not a mistaken English gloss.
next_data_requirements: Meaning-preserving native multi-turn responses, with genuine corrections, clarification and language switches; source news and translation views are not substitutes.
Balanced capability examples where tools are absent, inputs are missing, or available tools should not be used; grounded executed-tool trajectories for supported tools.
Review aligned native response targets and the clinical subset before expanding training; do not replay this unchanged mixture or claim more epochs will fix it.
